title: fix: correct off-by-one in retry backoff

commits.messageHeadline: fix: correct off-by-one in retry backoff

body:
## Why

The backoff loop retried one extra time on the max-attempts boundary, silently doubling the last wait interval before giving up.

## What

Changes `i <= maxAttempts` to `i < maxAttempts` in the retry loop.
